sub: Video, audio, broadcast and recording systems for public meetings. One partner designs, installs and supports it all.
intro_h: Public Meetings, Made Easy and Efficient
intro_p: Today's council meetings need to do more than ever. Attendees want to watch remotely, members may need to participate from another location, and meetings often must be recorded for compliance and archival purposes. We engineer one system that handles it all.
tech_p: Every chamber is different. We configure video, audio, broadcast and control around how your meetings actually run.

cards.alt: Council chamber dais with member displays
cards.p: Individual monitors for council members, large displays for attendees, and routing that sends each display exactly the content it needs.
Microphones for individuals or groups, with operator mute and leveling controls or fully automated, intelligent mixing.

cards.alt: Council chamber broadcast and control console
cards.p: Live broadcasts, recording and archiving for compliance, all run from one simple control interface.
b: Local or cloud recording and archiving
Button panels or touch panel dashboards

partner_p: One team designs, engineers, installs and supports your chambers, and trains the people who run them. You get one point of contact and one accountable partner.
gal_p: A selection of chambers and meeting rooms installed by our team.
